title: KLA Reports Q2 Results, Joins Visa, Western Digital And Other Big Stocks Moving Lower In Friday's Pre-Market Session
description:
U.S. stock futures were lower this morning, with the Dow futures falling around 100 points on Friday.

title: CymaBay Therapeutics, ContextLogic, Snap And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Monday
description:
U.S. stocks were mixed, with the Nasdaq Composite trading almost flat on Monday.
Shares of  CymaBay Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBAY) rose sharply in today’s pre-market trading.
Gilead Sciences agreed to acquire CymaBay Therapeutics for $32.50 per share in cash or a total equity value of $4.3 billion.
CymaBay Therapeutics shares jumped 24.5% to $31.99 on Monday.
